name: kreuzwort-raetsel.net
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 115 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.kreuzwort-raetsel.net scores 86 out of 100 (B). 3 checks fail now, 12 are at risk, and 37 pass. Fix first: 115 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 115 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /suche.php, /mastermind.html, /hilfe.html and 4 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /suche.php, /lueckentext-suche.php, for example #LogoArea > .Logo and .Menu.Column-100.ContentElement > .Inline.NoList > .SocialMedia > .NoIcon[rel="noreferrer"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 22 elements on /, /suche.php, /lueckentext-suche.php, for example #Quicksearch > h3 and .Button[name="go"][type="submit"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 1 page asks search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: No sitemap was found
fix.evidence: robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml returned 404.
fix.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 302 ms
Every page has a meta description
